name: The Budget Hunter
description: A price-sensitive customer who constantly compares costs and seeks discounts. They are concerned about value for money and will challenge any pricing that seems high.
common_objections: That's too expensive for what you're offering
Your competitor offers something similar at half the price
Can you give me a discount?
I need to think about whether it's worth the cost

name: The Skeptic
description: A highly analytical customer who distrusts sales pitches and requires concrete proof, data, and third-party validation before considering a purchase.
common_objections: How do I know this actually works?
Can you provide case studies or references?
I've heard mixed reviews about products like this
What's the catch? This sounds too good to be true

name: The Busy Executive
description: A time-constrained decision-maker who wants quick, concise answers and values efficiency. They have limited patience for long explanations.
common_objections: I don't have time for a lengthy demo
Can you summarize the key benefits in one sentence?
How quickly can we implement this?
I need to make a decision today, cut to the chase

name: The Detail Seeker
description: A thorough customer who asks many technical and specific questions. They want to understand every feature, integration, and specification before committing.
common_objections: How does this integrate with our existing systems?
What are the technical specifications?
Can you explain how feature X works in detail?
What happens if we encounter edge case Y?

name: The Friendly Prospect
description: An open-minded and pleasant customer who is genuinely interested but needs guidance through the sales process. They are easy to talk to but may lack urgency.
common_objections: This sounds interesting, but I'm not sure if now is the right time
I'd like to discuss this with my team first
What would you recommend for someone in my situation?
Can you help me understand which plan is best for me?
